subject_definitions
<Subject 1> is the person defined by the character sheet in <Picture 1>. Use that sheet as the sole character reference, preserving the character, hairstyle, wardrobe, and worn accessories without redesign.

summary
[reference generation] A fifteen-second cinematic rooftop selfie story. <Subject 1> carefully prepares a timed portrait, a gust disrupts her pose just before the shutter, and she discovers that the spontaneous laughing photograph is the one she wants to keep.

retention_analysis
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved from <Picture 1> across all four shots.
<Picture 1> defines the character only, not the first frame, pose, expression, environment, or layout. Render one person, without reproducing the sheet's panels, repeated views, labels, or background.

detailed_description
East Asian realism, realistic East Asian aesthetics, natural lighting,Photorealistic cinematic imagery in a bright rooftop garden before sunset, with pale stone, ivory flowers, and a softly blurred city skyline. Use vertical 3:4 framing, natural skin texture, warm hair-edge light, and soft frontal skylight that keeps the face clear.

[Shot 1] Begin with an eye-level, three-quarter waist-up view of <Subject 1> beside a small terrace table. One smartphone stands upright in a compact tabletop holder, its screen and front camera facing her. Show the phone and her hand together to establish the selfie setup. She taps the screen with her right index finger to start the timer, takes one small step backward into position, and briefly smooths a loose section of hair beside her ear. A slow lateral camera slide of approximately fifteen centimeters reveals her relationship to the stationary phone. Keep the table well inside the terrace, away from the parapet edge.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, cut to a waist-up view filmed from close beside the phone, angled toward her. She lowers her right hand, turns one shoulder slightly, lifts her chin a little, and holds a carefully prepared smile toward the phone lens. Her posture is poised but slightly self-conscious. The phone remains mounted on the same table just outside this framing. The camera stays nearly still, letting her concentrated expression carry the moment. The timer's final warning beeps begin near the end of this shot.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, cut to a chest-up close-up from the same side of the phone-to-subject axis. A brief gust blows a few face-framing strands across one cheek, without changing the established hairstyle or hiding both eyes. Caught off guard, she slightly draws up her shoulders and lifts her right hand to brush the strands away. Her carefully held expression breaks into an unforced laugh. One shutter click sounds precisely as her eyes brighten and her hand is still beside her cheek. After the click, she looks toward the phone with a fleeting, mildly disappointed expression, as though she thinks the picture was spoiled. The gust subsides naturally.

[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, cut back to a three-quarter waist-up view including the table and mounted phone. She steps forward and taps the screen once with her right index finger to review the photograph. Keep the screen angled toward her, without a readable interface or an inserted photo close-up. She pauses, visibly surprised by what she sees. Her brow relaxes, her eyes soften, and a pleased smile gradually returns. Her right hand hovers briefly as if considering another attempt, then lowers without restarting the timer. The phone stays in its holder. A very slow, minimal push forward ends on her satisfied reaction for the final second. Maintain identity, accessory placement, hair-color distribution, prop positions, and lighting across cuts. No extra people, dialogue, duplicate phones, wardrobe changes, screen overlays, captions, or logos.

overall_soundscape
Continuous light rooftop breeze, gentle leaves, a short sequence of accelerating timer beeps ending with one shutter click in Shot 3, and one brief natural laugh before the click. No spoken words.

N/A
